audit.why: 54.23% over 697 games supports EVEN at 5.5/10 tilting to Lissandra after 6. Taliyah out-ranges her at every level (Q 1000, W 900, E 950 vs Q 725, W 450) but has no dash and no burst all-in, so the lane is a poke standoff that Frozen Tomb ends.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side read Taliyah and phases[5].side / phases[6].side read Skill, while content win[0] read Skill and win[5] / win[6] read Lissandra — three rows rendering two different answers. packet.levelChart matches the content layer.
audit.why: Level 1 neither champion has a kill pattern, so Skill is right. From first item Lissandra's point-and-click W-R catches a champion with no dash whose only escape is a 180s Weaver's Wall, so those rows belong to Lissandra — and phases[5].why and phases[6].why already described Lissandra winning under a Skill row.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Skill (why rewritten), phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Lissandra (whys already matched).

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of this matchup was never stated anywhere on the page: Unraveled Earth's mines explode and stun enemies who DASH through them, and Lissandra's E is a dash. packet.defects also notes no Taliyah ability was ever named, and breakdown.cooldowns held no digit.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Unraveled Earth: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Lissandra's E recast transports her — a dash — so clawing into her mines self-stuns, and her E is a flat 14s while Lissandra's is 24s at rank 1. Seismic Shove can also knock you into her own mines for the same stun.
audit.corrected: Written into tldr, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading and dosFull[1].d with the real cooldowns.

audit.why: The kit file carries a 'grounding' flag on Taliyah's Q and W, but Riot's descriptions for Threaded Volley and Seismic Shove say nothing about grounding. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted no grounding anywhere in the text.

notes: Chart rows 0, 5 and 6 disagreed across layers; I moved the full layer onto the content layer's values (which match packet.levelChart), so there is no paired win[N] edit to write — the content values are already the targets. phases[5].why and phases[6].why already described Lissandra winning, so they needed no rewrite; phases[0].why did and was rewritten in the same proposal. Six report entries carried MISGENDER findings, above the two-report sweep limit; I applied pronoun-only swaps rather than rewrites, plus report[0].t which had to track the new tldr. The kit file's 'grounding' flags on Taliyah's Q and W contradict Riot's descriptions, so I asserted no grounding — worth checking, because if Threaded Volley or Seismic Shove really did ground, it would deny Lissandra's E and change this lane's verdict. spikes[2].text is 141 vs 117 before (+20%) and may be rejected by the length band; the mine-stun interaction is the single most important fact in this matchup and also lives in tldr, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.trading, so it survives regardless.
